thing.note: A robot that trains a robot. It reads the first pad out, gives the box of 1 to the little robot in its second hole and teaches it to add a fresh 1 to what it was given, has Ruby loosen the 1 in the pupil’s thought so it counts on any number, and reads the last pad out. It runs once: with the pupil gone from its box, its thought no longer fits.

thing.text:
THE TEACHER

A robot trained to train a
robot. Its box holds a pad,
a little robot, a box with
a 1, and another pad.

Run, it reads the pad out,
gives the box to the little
robot, and TEACHES it: the
pupil steps up to a desk of
its own and does each step
as the teacher shows it.

TO RUN IT

Give the four-hole box to
the teacher and press Start.

Watch the pupil take a desk,
add a fresh 1 to its box,
and have its thought
loosened by Ruby.

Then click the pupil -- it is
trained now -- and press
Start: 3, 4, 5, ...

HOW IT WAS TAUGHT

In the teacher’s lesson, the
claw took the box and was
dropped on the little robot.
That is “teach”: everything
done next was the PUPIL’s
lesson, and the teacher kept
each step as a “taught” step
of its own.

Read on a pad in a lesson is
a step too: the robot reads
it out when it runs.
